dependency_semantics: Comparison gates require one shared source witness. Matching scalar outputs or separate successes do not supply transport. Links to the math branch are scope references, not cyclic proof dependencies.

conjectures.statement: Specify one source and typed maps to mathematical and physical-process realizations with compatible identities, composition, resources and available continuations.
conjectures.acceptance: Fix domains, contexts and both routes before comparing results; state which physical ingredients are premises versus justified realizations.
conjectures.falsifier: The two routes require different hidden source choices or resource policies.
conjectures.scope: Definition and bounded regression interface, not a common physical constructor or universal compatibility theorem.

conjectures.statement: Use the SAME RH example as in the mathematical-realization net to test compatibility of its arithmetic/analytic realizations with the proposed common physical-process account.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct same-witness operation/domain/identity/continuation comparisons. Reuse the mathematical example without inferring physical realization from analytic positivity or a formal analogy.
conjectures.falsifier: A mathematical realization succeeds but the independently specified source/process comparison fails, including an uncancelled typed residual.

conjectures.statement: Attach scoped physics-programme comparisons to the same source interface.
conjectures.acceptance: Preserve existing accepted finite results and failed source-operation bridges at their own scopes; do not merge incompatible carriers by dimension or equal energy.
conjectures.falsifier: An abstract embedding has no compatible source operation or continuation on the physical side.

conjectures.statement: The bounded comparison examples use one coherent same-source notion.
conjectures.acceptance: Review overlap witnesses and higher compatibility; examples do not establish the universal parent theorem.
conjectures.falsifier: Pairwise comparisons cannot compose coherently on their declared common source.
